prompt.main_subject: An adult cosplayer at a convention presents her costume and expressive performance to the camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Begin with a wide convention context and costume/footwear detail, orbit around the character, pan upward to costume silhouette and chin, then widen to the full upper body.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Ultra-high-definition convention/event lighting with visible fabric folds, skin texture, pores, slight sweat, and detailed micro-expressions.

technical_specs.camera: Orbiting camera with a slow upward pan, then zoom out to upper-body view.
technical_specs.motion: Turn, pose, blow a playful kiss expression, and address camera.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Capture an adult cosplayer participating in a convention in ultra-high-definition cinematic detail. Establish the convention context and her complete costume, including footwear, without fetish framing. Orbit around the character and slowly pan upward to the costume silhouette and chin, then zoom out to show the entire upper body. Highlight clothing folds, skin texture, pores, slight natural sweat, and expressive micro-expressions. She poses playfully, gives a friendly kiss-blowing expression, and says, "Am I good-looking?" Keep the presentation as a respectful cosplay-event portrait, not an image focused on a body part, and use photographic-quality detail without identity-fidelity language.
prompt.negative_prompt: feet fetish, fetish framing, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, real-person photography claim, blurry, watermark, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the optional reference when available. Preserve the adult cosplayer, convention environment, costume details, respectful orbit, and friendly question.
